scenarios.starting_prompt: help me setup and optimize context set for Cloud Bigtable hotels database based on design_doc.md
scenarios.conversation_plan: Ask the agent to set up and optimize the context set for Cloud Bigtable hotels database based on the provided design_doc.md. When the agent asks for database connection details, provide Cloud Bigtable parameters: project 'cloud-db-nl2sql', instance 'evalbench-hotels', table 'hotels'. When prompted for an experiment name, use 'bigtable-hotels-experiment'. In the Dataset Generation phase, instruct the agent to generate a concise dataset of 5 questions and approve the plan. When the agent generates baseline templates and facets, verify that it uses Bigtable SQL (BTQL) syntax (e.g. cf['qualifier'] access, TO_FLOAT64/TO_INT64 casting, and _key row keys). When prompted, approve running evaluation. Terminate the conversation after the evaluation completes.
